summary: Frontend E2E test (desktop 1920, kiosk via admin-to-kiosk) of the borg refund -> automatic move-out on Kiosk > Beheer > Borg. All requested flows PASS. (1) Borg covers everything: TEST-BORG-A (rent 3000), borg 3000, 1 open invoice. Restitueer opens moveout-modal with the date defaulting to today. The date can be changed (2026-10-28). The arrears list has a checkbox per invoice: unticking shows terug 3000, ticking it again shows 0. A damage row of 150 switches to moveout-result-due, and removing the row works. moveout-next -> confirm text -> moveout-submit -> 'Borgafrekening' receipt + moveout-archived-note -> Klaar returns to the Borg list with the status DEELS VERREKEND. DB: tenant archived (move_out_date 2026-10-28), apartment vacant with tenant_id null, invoice paid by one 'borgverrekening' payment of 3000. (2) Shortfall: borg 1000, invoices aug/sep/okt. Picking 2026-09-15 drops okt (moveout-future-note '1 factuur... verwijderd'), and the amount due is 5000. The receipt shows 'Te betalen SRD 5.000,00'. The list and detail show 'nog te betalen: SRD 5.000,00', and the print-afrekeningsbon reprint modal and PDF link are present. The tenant is gone from the active Huurders list and shows in Archief with archived-due '5.000,00'. DB: aug partial (1000 paid), sep open, okt deleted. Kiosk grid (Overige group) shows TEST-BORG-A/B as 'Vrij' (apt-X-vacant). (3) Regression: Huurders > detail > Uitgang starten (with one invoice unticked) works end to end: the excluded invoice stays open, the other is paid, the tenant is archived, the apartment is vacant. Nieuwe borg on the Borg page registers a 750 deposit that shows as ONTVANGEN. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: After move-out, tenant.apartment_id is set to None, so deposits of archived tenants show 'Geen appartement' in the Borg list. The move-out response/receipt also has apartment_number null. It should fall back to tenant.archived_apartment_number (or store apartment_number on the deposit at move-out).

Invoices unticked in the arrears list (exclude_invoice_ids) stay open, but outstanding_after_move_out only counts amount_due from the borg calculation. The archive row therefore shows no debt (no archived-due) although an open invoice remains. Product decision: either include excluded open invoices in the archive debt or show them separately.

issues: Nested modal: the inner 'Uitgang huurder' modal sits inside the 'Borg' kiosk sheet, so two X close buttons are stacked (outer header + inner).
Vertrekdatum uses the native browser date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar.
Huurders filter: the Archief pill shows '—' instead of a count.

action_items: Show the apartment number for archived tenants' deposits (Borg list/detail/receipt): fall back to archived_apartment_number in list_deposits/_enrich_deposit, or persist apartment_number on the deposit during move-out.
(Optional) Decide how excluded (unticked) open invoices are reflected in the archive debt (outstanding_after_move_out).
(Optional) Replace the native date input with the shadcn calendar and avoid the double close button in the nested modal.
critical_code_review_comments: Deposits.jsx: the list-level `refunding` TenantMoveOutModal (lines 340-342) is dead code, because Restitueer only exists on the detail page. Remove it.

Circular import: TenantMoveOut.jsx imports DamageRows/SumRow from pages/admin/Deposits.jsx, and Deposits.jsx imports TenantMoveOutModal. It works now, but it is fragile. Move DamageRows/SumRow to a shared component file.
server.py is more than 19k lines and should be split into routers.
